class_10.title: Science Stream with Mathematics (PCM)
class_10.description: Rigorous foundation in analytical problem-solving, mechanics, and physical sciences. Prepares students for engineering, computing, architecture, pure sciences, and aviation.
typical_subjects: Informatics Practices / Computer Science / Physical Education
class_10.eligibility_prerequisites: Completion of Class 10 with strong interest and foundation in Mathematics and Science.
entrance_examinations: Prepares for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, BITSAT, State CETs, CUET-UG, NATA, NDA
class_10.alternative_routes: Polytechnic 3-year Engineering Diploma provides direct lateral entry into 2nd year B.Tech if hands-on technical study is preferred.

class_10.title: Science Stream with Biology (PCB)
class_10.description: Focuses on living systems, human anatomy, chemical interactions, and biology. Prepares students for medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, nursing, biotechnology, and agricultural sciences.
class_10.eligibility_prerequisites: Completion of Class 10 with strong interest in Science and Biology.
entrance_examinations: Prepares for NEET-UG, CUET-UG (B.Sc Life Sciences / B.Pharm), ICAR AIEEA
class_10.alternative_routes: Allied healthcare diplomas (DMLT, Radiography, Dialysis Tech) or Paramedical certifications allow earlier healthcare workforce entry.

class_10.title: Science Stream with Math & Biology (PCMB)
class_10.description: Dual pathway offering comprehensive coverage of both mathematical sciences and life sciences. Maximum career flexibility across biomedical engineering, bioinformatics, medicine, and engineering.
class_10.eligibility_prerequisites: Completion of Class 10 with high aptitude and willingness to balance heavy coursework.
entrance_examinations: Prepares for JEE, NEET-UG, CUET-UG, IISER Aptitude Test, ICAR AIEEA
class_10.alternative_routes: Students can drop one optional domain during college admissions depending on their final focus.

class_10.title: Commerce Stream with Mathematics
class_10.description: Combines financial literacy, corporate accounts, business laws, and quantitative analytical methods. Gateway to chartered accountancy, investment banking, economics, and corporate leadership.
class_10.eligibility_prerequisites: Completion of Class 10 with interest in numbers, business, and analytical reasoning.
entrance_examinations: Prepares for CA Foundation, CUET-UG (B.Com Hons, Economics Hons), IPMAT, CLAT
class_10.alternative_routes: Applied Mathematics syllabus (CBSE) offers business-oriented quantitative methods rather than theoretical calculus.

class_10.title: Commerce Stream without Mathematics
class_10.description: Focuses on business operations, trade practices, accounting principles, taxation, and entrepreneurship without intensive calculus requirements.
class_10.eligibility_prerequisites: Completion of Class 10 with interest in commercial enterprises and business operations.
entrance_examinations: Prepares for CUET-UG (B.Com, BBA), CMA Foundation, CS Foundation, CLAT, NCHMCT JEE
class_10.alternative_routes: Can pursue BBA, BMS, Law (5-year integrated), Hotel Management, or Mass Communication.

class_10.title: Humanities and Arts Stream
class_10.description: Explores human society, culture, governance, psychological behavior, history, and creative communication. Foundation for civil services, law, journalism, public policy, and design.
class_10.eligibility_prerequisites: Completion of Class 10 with interest in reading, writing, critical analysis, and social systems.
entrance_examinations: Prepares for CUET-UG (BA Hons), CLAT, AILET, NID DAT, UCEED, NCHMCT JEE
class_10.alternative_routes: Economics can be paired with Humanities to keep finance and public policy options open.

class_10.title: Polytechnic Engineering Diploma
class_10.description: Hands-on, practice-oriented engineering curriculum emphasizing laboratory work, workshop skills, and technical application. Allows lateral entry into the 2nd year of B.Tech.
class_10.eligibility_prerequisites: Pass in Class 10 with Mathematics and Science; State Polytechnic Entrance Exam (POLYCET / JEECUP).
class_10.alternative_routes: After 3-year diploma, direct lateral entry into 2nd year B.E./B.Tech via state lateral entrance tests (LEET).

class_10.title: Vocational Education & ITI Training (NSQF)
class_10.description: Skill-focused trade training under the National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF). Immediate job-readiness in electrician, machinist, draftsperson, or solar technician trades.
class_10.eligibility_prerequisites: Class 10 pass from a recognized board.
entrance_examinations: State ITI Merit Admission / Trades Entrance Test
class_10.alternative_routes: Apprenticeship training under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) with stipend.

class_12.title: B.Tech / B.E. in Engineering & Computer Science
class_12.description: Four-year professional degree covering engineering fundamentals, algorithms, electronics, mechanics, or civil infrastructure. Top branches include CS, AI/ML, Electronics, Mechanical, and Civil.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) in 10+2 with minimum 50-60% aggregate (or 75% for NITs/IITs).
entrance_examinations: State Engineering CETs (MHT CET, KCET, WBJEE, etc.)
class_12.alternative_routes: If JEE ranks are insufficient, explore BCA + MCA, B.Sc Computer Science / Data Science, or AICTE-approved state universities.

class_12.title: MBBS, BDS & Allied Clinical Medicine
class_12.description: Undergraduate medical training qualifying graduates as licensed medical practitioners. Covers pathology, pharmacology, surgery, medicine, obstetrics, and community health.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology (PCB) in 10+2 with at least 50% aggregate (40% for reserved categories).
class_12.alternative_routes: BDS (Dentistry), BAMS (Ayurveda), BHMS (Homeopathy), B.Sc Nursing, BPT (Physiotherapy), or B.Pharm.

class_12.title: B.Sc Nursing & Paramedical / Allied Health Sciences
class_12.description: Essential healthcare degree programs preparing registered nurses, physical therapists, radiographers, and clinical diagnostic technologists.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: 10+2 with PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) and English, typically 45-50% minimum aggregate.
class_12.alternative_routes: GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery 3 years) diploma offers clinical nursing entry with later post-basic B.Sc upgrade.

class_12.title: B.Sc / B.S. in Pure Sciences & Data Mathematics
class_12.description: Three to four-year undergraduate curriculum (under NEP 4-year honors with research) in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Statistics, or Data Science.
typical_subjects: Quantum Mechanics / Organic Chemistry / Statistical Modeling
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: 10+2 with relevant science/math subjects and minimum 50% aggregate.
class_12.alternative_routes: Integrated M.Sc / BS-MS at IISERs, NISER, or IITs through IAT or JEE Advanced.

class_12.title: B.Sc / B.Tech in Biotechnology & Life Sciences
class_12.description: Intersection of biological principles and engineering technologies. Covers genetic engineering, bioinformatics, bioprocess tech, and vaccine research.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: 10+2 with PCB or PCMB with minimum 50% aggregate.
class_12.alternative_routes: B.Pharm (4-year Bachelor of Pharmacy) provides recognized licensing for clinical manufacturing and pharmaceutical research.

class_12.title: B.Com (Hons) & Chartered Accountancy (CA / CMA / CS)
class_12.description: Gold-standard financial and accounting pathway. Combines corporate financial reporting, statutory auditing, direct and indirect taxation, and commercial law.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: 10+2 from any stream (Commerce preferred). Mathematics often mandatory for premier B.Com (Hons) universities.
entrance_examinations: CUET-UG (for top central universities like DU)
class_12.typical_duration: 3 to 4 years for B.Com; CA takes 4–5 years parallel to degree
class_12.alternative_routes: Global accounting certifications such as ACCA (UK) or CMA (US) offer substantial exemptions for commerce graduates.
official_sources: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (icai.org)

class_12.title: BBA, BMS & Integrated Management (IPM)
class_12.description: Business management and leadership education covering organizational behavior, marketing strategy, operations, corporate finance, and business analytics.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 50-60% aggregate.
class_12.alternative_routes: Pursue standard Bachelor degree followed by CAT / XAT for regular 2-year postgrad MBA at premier institutions.

class_12.title: 5-Year Integrated Law (B.A. LL.B / B.B.A. LL.B)
class_12.description: Comprehensive legal education leading to enrollment as an advocate with the Bar Council of India. Covers constitutional law, criminal law, corporate law, and intellectual property.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 45% aggregate (40% for SC/ST).
entrance_examinations: CLAT (Common Law Admission Test for NLUs)
class_12.alternative_routes: Can pursue 3-year LL.B degree after completing any regular 3-year bachelor's degree via CUET-PG or state law tests.

class_12.title: B.Des (Design) & B.Arch (Architecture)
class_12.description: Fusing aesthetic intuition with functional ergonomics, digital interface design, spatial planning, and physical fabrication.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: For B.Des: 10+2 any stream. For B.Arch: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with minimum 50% marks.
class_12.typical_duration: 4 years for B.Des; 5 years for B.Arch
class_12.alternative_routes: Self-taught design portfolio + online certification (Figma, Blender) combined with a general degree can also break into UI/UX.

class_12.title: B.A. in Journalism & Mass Communication (BJMC)
class_12.description: Hands-on training in investigative journalism, broadcast news, digital content creation, podcasting, public relations, and media law.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: 10+2 in any stream with strong language and communication skills.
class_12.alternative_routes: Students passionate about media can also study Political Science or English Literature while managing digital publications.

class_12.title: B.A. / B.Sc in Psychology & Behavioral Sciences
class_12.description: Study of human mind, cognitive processes, emotional development, psychological testing, and psychopathology. Stepping stone to clinical, counseling, or industrial psychology.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 50% aggregate.
class_12.alternative_routes: Clinical practice in India requires subsequent M.A./M.Sc in Psychology followed by RCI-licensed M.Phil/Psy.D clinical training.

class_12.title: B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture & Environmental Sciences
class_12.description: Scientific study of crop production, soil science, plant genetics, agricultural economics, water conservation, and precision farming technologies.
class_12.eligibility_prerequisites: 10+2 with PCB, PCM, or Agriculture with minimum 50% aggregate.
class_12.typical_duration: 4 years (including Rural Agricultural Work Experience - RAWE)
class_12.alternative_routes: Agribusiness MBA (PGDM-ABM) post-graduation opens lucrative agribusiness corporate and supply chain management positions.

graduate.title: Postgraduate Technical Degrees (M.Tech / M.S. Research / Ph.D.)
graduate.description: Deep specialization in bleeding-edge technical domains: Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, VLSI Design, Quantum Computing, or Structural Dynamics.
graduate.eligibility_prerequisites: B.Tech / B.E. / M.Sc in relevant field with minimum 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA.
graduate.alternative_routes: Sponsored industry masters programs or part-time executive M.Tech while working full-time in R&D.

graduate.title: Master of Business Administration (MBA / PGDM)
graduate.description: Transforms graduates into organizational leaders, product managers, investment bankers, strategy consultants, and entrepreneurs.
graduate.eligibility_prerequisites: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with minimum 50% aggregate (45% for reserved categories).
graduate.alternative_routes: 1-year Executive MBA programs (e.g. IIM PGPX, ISB PGP) for professionals with 3+ years of work experience.

graduate.title: Civil Services & Public Administration (UPSC CSE / State PSC)
graduate.description: The premier civil service pathway in India. Recruits officers for IAS (Administrative), IPS (Police), IFS (Foreign), IRS (Revenue), and allied central services.
typical_subjects: General Studies (History, Polity, Economy, Geography, Ethics)
graduate.eligibility_prerequisites: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university. Minimum age 21 years.
entrance_examinations: UPSC Civil Services Examination (Prelims, Mains, Personality Test / Interview)
graduate.typical_duration: 1 to 2 years of rigorous competitive preparation
graduate.alternative_routes: State Public Service Commission exams (Provincial Civil Services), SSC CGL, or RBI Grade B Officer examinations.

graduate.title: Master of Medicine / Surgery (MD / MS / MDS / DNB)
graduate.description: Specialized clinical or surgical practice qualification in Cardiology, Neurology, Pediatrics, Orthopedics, Radiology, or Psychiatry.
graduate.eligibility_prerequisites: MBBS / BDS degree with completed compulsory rotatory internship and permanent NMC/DCI registration.
entrance_examinations: NEET-PG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test - Postgraduate)
graduate.alternative_routes: Fellowship of the National Board (FNB) or specialized clinical diplomas.

graduate.title: Professional Data Science & AI Specializations
graduate.description: Industry-aligned pathway into machine learning engineering, data architecture, MLOps, and quantitative analytics.
graduate.eligibility_prerequisites: Bachelor's degree with quantitative or programming fundamentals.
entrance_examinations: Direct industry admission / Technical aptitude test / IIT Madras BS/Diploma in Data Science
graduate.typical_duration: 6 to 12 months (or 2 years for M.Sc Data Science)
graduate.alternative_routes: Open-source GitHub contributions + Kaggle competitions + certifications (AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Cloud Data Engineer).

graduate.title: Master of Laws (LL.M.) & Judicial Services
graduate.description: Advanced legal specialization in International Commercial Arbitration, Cyber Law, Constitutional Jurisprudence, or Corporate Mergers & Acquisitions.
graduate.eligibility_prerequisites: Three-year or five-year LL.B degree from a recognized university with minimum 50-55% aggregate.
graduate.alternative_routes: State Judicial Services Examination for appointment as Civil Judge (Junior Division) / Judicial Magistrate directly after LL.B.
official_sources: High Courts & State Public Service Commissions
